name: The Mabin School

description: Progressive, inquiry-based JK–Grade 6 school of about 150 students in midtown Toronto (founded 1980); student-led multi-month collaborative inquiries; Canada's first independent Ashoka Changemaker School.

attributes.philosophy: Inquiry, integration and reflection; 'students' questions lead the way'; multidisciplinary inquiries lasting months; play and creativity woven through JK–6.

legal_status.label: Private school operating under a Notice of Intention to Operate (Education Act s.16, Ontario)

attributes.curriculum: School-designed inquiry curriculum; French from JK.

tuition.notes: Returning-student tuition 2026-2027 $37,400; one-time New Student Registration Fee (amount not stated); application fee $200.

attributes.additional_fees: Application $200; new-student registration fee (amount not published).
attributes.admission: Inquiry form, private tour, application opening in the fall one year before entry.
advantages: Deep, student-led inquiry model with small community
attributes.qualifying_reason: On Ontario's private-school list (no. 881090); inquiry/project-based model described concretely (multi-month student-led inquiries) on the official site; 2026-27 tuition published.
